data.name: Negaah
data.gender_notes: Negaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-g-h', meaning 'to look, see, observe'. In Islamic tradition, 'Negaah' symbolizes the importance of seeking knowledge and gaining insight through observation and introspection. The name Negaah carries the meaning “Gaze, Sight, Vision” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Negaah usually hope their child will grow to embody gaze, sight, vision and live with faith, good character and purpose.
